flows:
Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:4173/ then Open Hati with no saved data (clear this site's browser storage and reload if any bills or people exist).
Add the people Ana, Ben and Cy.
Add a bill named Rent with amount 900.00, paid by Ana, split equally between Ana, Ben and Cy.
Add a bill named Electricity with amount 300.00, paid by Ben, split equally between Ana, Ben and Cy.
Open Settle up and count the payments listed.
Assert Settle up lists exactly two payments.
Assert Ben pays Ana 300.00 appears among the payments or Cy is shown as paying.
Get the number of payments listed in Settle up, as a digit and save as {{payment_count}}.

remark: wait: PRIMARY: confirm Hati has no saved people or bills
wait: queued plan (2 steps): type "Name"; click "Add person"
wait: queued plan (2 steps): type "Name"; click "Add person"
wait: queued plan (2 steps): type "Name"; click "Add person"
wait: queued plan (6 steps): type "Bill name"; type "Amount"; click "Ana"; click "Ben"
wait: PRIMARY: confirm the Rent bill was added
wait: queued plan (4 steps): type "Bill name"; type "Amount"; select "Paid by"; click
wait: PRIMARY: confirm the Electricity bill was added

summary:
The agent used all available steps while setting up the people and bills. The last successful evidence shows Electricity was added, but the agent did not continue to the Settle up section before the 25-step limit was reached.
Use a shorter setup plan and avoid redundant confirmation waits. After adding Electricity, scroll to Settle up immediately, count the displayed payments, verify the required payment text, and save the digit as payment_count.
one_liner: The run ended after adding the second bill, before it opened Settle up, counted payments, or saved the payment count.
